places.quote: went his way up Tottenham Court Road, carrying the flower-pot affectionately in his arms
places.note: Traddles and Peggotty are on this street; the name appears twice (also 'the street in Tottenham Court Road').

places.quote: We were thus a good while in getting to the Adelphi.
places.note: Site of David's chambers; the Adelphi is an riverside building complex and district.

places.quote: don't call the woman by that South Sea Island name!
places.note: Generic allusion to Pacific islands as a figure of speech, not a specific island.
